title: FLA import: video symbol (CPicVideo) not handled
description: No CPicVideo case in FLA element dispatch — Video symbol instance on stage hits generic not-supported fallback. SWF encoder already emits DefineVideoStream and VideoFrame from VideoItem model objects (compile.ts lines 673-730) but binary FLA round-trip never populates those items. Needs CPicVideo parser + flash8-import.ts wiring + verification against FLV Media stream.
